sam_sales: Hi team — Athena (prospect) asked for a quick POC checklist. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and per-tenant RBAC mapping. Also asking whether we can support domain-level locking for tenant claims.
jas_eng: Thanks — are they expecting Hosted or Dedicated for the POC?
sam_sales: They prefer Hosted to start, but raised questions about SLA and whether SCIM deltas will trigger extra charges. Pricing team said large active-user syncs might push them to Dedicated later.
priya_se: Quick technical notes: Hosted supports SAML and SCIM out of the box. Domain verification is via TXT on the DNS or an email flow — we can do tenant claim validation either way. RBAC mapping uses SCIM groups -> app roles mapping or our provisioning webhook.
alex_security: Important: for enterprise audit we need SAML assertion attribute mapping: email, subject, tenant_id. Also they requested signed responses + SP-initiated + IdP metadata upload. Confirm if we support encrypted assertions (they asked).
jas_eng: We support signed assertions and SP-initiated flows today. Encrypted assertions are not enabled by default — it's a configuration option but requires extra cert/key configuration on the Private/Dedicated plane. For Hosted POC we can accept signed assertions only.
sam_sales: Noted — pass that to Athena. Also they asked about SCIM rate limits: what is the delta sync throughput?
priya_se: Hosted SCIM default: 60 req/min per org, with bulk provisioning endpoint for initial syncs. For heavy syncs we recommend batching via our bulk endpoint. Example curl for bulk import: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/bulk -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @bulk_users.json
```
priya_se: If they need >60rpm sustained, we can open a temporary burst for the POC (subject to support approval). That avoids switching to Dedicated immediately.
alex_security: On RBAC: we can map SCIM groups to roles, but fine-grained claims (like resource-level entitlements) require a small App-side mapping lambda or our role-mapping webhook. Does Athena expect attribute-based access control or simple role groups?
sam_sales: Sales call said they want role-per-repo style control (fine-grained). Might need mapping webhook. Can we demo a lambda mapping during POC?
jas_eng: Yes — we can ship a sample mapping webhook (node/py) and host it on our sandbox. We'll need Athena to provide their role schema.
sam_sales: Great. Also customer asked about domain locking: they want only certain verified domains to be allowed to register. Is that a config flag?
priya_se: Yes — we offer "restrict_signup_to_verified_domains" per-tenant. For Hosted POC we can enable it after domain TXT verification.
sam_sales: Pricing question — if we enable SCIM burst and custom webhook for the POC, is there an extra fee?
jas_eng: SCIM burst is free for short-term POC but we bill sustained high throughput. Custom webhook dev + hosted sandbox is included in enterprise POC for deals > $X (sales to confirm).
priya_se: Also call out session length and SAML session mapping. Default token TTL is 1h, adjustable for Dedicated. Athena wants 12h sessions — for Hosted we can extend to 8h; Dedicated allows arbitrary TTLs per contract.
sam_sales: Action items: 1) I'll confirm Hosted vs Dedicated preference with Athena. 2) Jas to prepare mapping webhook sample + instructions. 3) Priya to prepare SCIM bulk sample and request temporary burst in case. 4) Alex to produce a short security note about encrypted assertions and audit logging.
alex_security: Will do — I'll attach a one-pager in the next message. :+1:
deploy-bot: Note: sandbox environment (sid-az4) scheduled for Athena demo on 2024-10-04 14:00 UTC.
sam_sales: Thanks all — I'll schedule a technical runbook call with Athena for tomorrow. :wave:
